## Import



tse cloud native api gateway ip restriction can be imported using the composite id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Tse/cloudNativeApiGatewayIpRestriction:CloudNativeApiGatewayIpRestriction example gatewayId#sourceType#sourceId
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
